purpose: Test competition proposal: sharing boundary versus negative transfer, not specialist leaderboard search
data_protocol: reuse preliminary_v1 development folds; legacy test subjects excluded
initialization: same public CBraMod, same task heads and random states as original J/S controls

training.selection: mean of three task subject-mean validation BAs

capacity_control.select: eligible depth with highest mean task validation BA; smaller depth if exactly tied
capacity_control.purpose: same total parameters, active depth, update count, initialization and sample schedule, but each branch trains on all three tasks rather than one fixed task

new_fits: 6 mandatory, plus 3 conditional capacity controls only if gate passes
uncertainty: fold and training seed vary together; no statistical significance claim or fresh blind test
task_addons: not mixed into boundary experiment; prior specialist and normalization results do not prove benefit to shared backbone
